notes: internal/proxy/admin_dataworks.go:353 parseExpiryHorizon multiplies the day/week count by the unit without an overflow guard, so an absurd value such as ?expiring_within=200000d wraps int64 to a negative duration and is returned with ok=true. The deadline then lands in the past and the endpoint answers with an empty/incorrect expiring set instead of the 400 the doc comment promises for non-positive windows. Only reachable with unrealistic admin input, so low impact, but it contradicts the stated contract.

internal/proxy/admin_dataworks.go:288 and internal/proxy/admin_ui.go:14575 verified: entitlementExpiresWithin uses Before(deadline) while entitlementExpired uses Before(now) and the inactive branch continues, so no entitlement is counted in both inactive_access and expiring_access; the admin tab sum is therefore correct.
